js: (async()=>{const j=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/intents')).json();const run=j.intents.filter(i=>i.status==='running').map(i=>i.id);const all=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-im=\"preview\"][data-intent-id]")];const byId={};for(const e of all){const id=e.getAttribute('data-intent-id');const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width>0&&r.height>0){(byId[id]=byId[id]||[]).push({cls:e.className,w:Math.round(r.width),h:Math.round(r.height),x:Math.round(r.x),y:Math.round(r.y)})}}return JSON.stringify({running:run,visiblePreviewIds:Object.keys(byId),detail:byId})})()
